examples.arabic: والدي، أبو حسن، كان بيحاول يصلح المروحة القديمة في الصالة، وهو بيقول "الجو حر جدا دلوقتي يا جماعة!"
examples.english: My father, Abu Hassan, was trying to fix the old fan in the hall, saying, "The weather is very hot now, folks!"
examples.transliteration: Walidi, Abu Hassan, kan bihayawel yessalah el-marwaha el-adeema fel-sala, we howa bi'ool "El-gaww harr geddan delwa'ti ya gama'a!"

examples.arabic: أخويا الكبير أحمد زعق من الفرحة وكلم أمنا فيديو عشان يوريها الجمال ده.
examples.english: My big brother Ahmed shouted with joy and called our mother on video to show her this beauty.
examples.transliteration: Akhoya el kebir Ahmed za'a men el farha we kalem omena video ashan yoriha el gamal da.

examples.arabic: اخويا بيشتغل في بيت كبير مع العيلة
examples.english: My brother works in a big house with the family.
examples.transliteration: akhoya biyeshtaghal fi beit kabeer ma el eila

examples.arabic: اخويا بيشتغل في القاهرة من امبارح
examples.english: My brother works in Cairo since yesterday
examples.transliteration: Akhoya biyeshtaghal fel Qahera men embareh

examples.arabic: “يا عم محمود، كورتنا وقعت.” قال كريم.
examples.english: "Uncle Mahmoud, our ball fell." Karim said.
examples.transliteration: “Ya 3am Ma7moud, kortena wa2a3et.” al Karim.
examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

examples.arabic: بعدين، راحوا عند عم محمود يسألوه.
examples.english: Then, they went to Uncle Mahmoud to ask him.
examples.transliteration: Ba3dein, ra7o 3and 3amm Mahmoud yes'aluh.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: "يا عم محمود، أنا عايز ساندوتش فول بسرعة!"
examples.english: "Uncle Mahmoud, I want a ful sandwich quickly!"
examples.transliteration: "Ya am Mahmoud, ana ayiz sandwitsh ful bisuraa!"

examples.arabic: اهلا بيكي يا حبيبتي انا كويسة والولاد عاملين ايه
examples.english: Welcome, my dear, I'm good, and how are the children?
examples.transliteration: Ahlan beeki ya habibty, ana kwayesa wel awlad aamleen eih?

examples.arabic: الولاد مبسوطين قوي بالرحلة
examples.english: The children are very happy with the trip.
examples.transliteration: El-wilaad mabsoo6een qawi bel-re7la.

examples.arabic: كل يوم بيسأل ماما ليه السما زرقا
examples.english: Every day he asks Mama why the sky is blue.
examples.transliteration: Koll yoom beyes'al Mama leh el sama zar'a.

examples.arabic: ماما كانت بتعمل شاي ريحته حلوة فكريم سأل من فضلكي ليه الشاي سخن اوي
examples.english: Mama was making sweet-smelling tea, so Karim asked, "Please, why is the tea very hot?"
examples.transliteration: Mama kanet bet'amel shay rehto helwa fakareem sa'al min fadliki leeh el shay sokhn awi

examples.arabic: صباح الخير يا ماما أنا صحيت بدري النهاردة عشان عيد ميلادي
examples.english: Good morning, Mama, I woke up early today because it's my birthday.
examples.transliteration: Sabaḥ el-kheer ya Mama, ana ṣaḥeet badry el-naharda 'ashan 'eid miladi.

examples.arabic: امي عملت اكل صحي كتير
examples.english: My mother made a lot of healthy food.
examples.transliteration: ommi aamalet akl sehhi keteer

examples.arabic: امي بتطبخ لحمة ورز حلو اوي
examples.english: My mother cooks very delicious meat and rice.
examples.transliteration: Omi betotbokh lahma we roz helw awi

examples.arabic: امي بتطبخ اكل كتير عشان المعازيم
examples.english: My mother is cooking a lot of food for the guests.
examples.transliteration: ommy betotbokh akl keteer ashan el maazeem

examples.arabic: بابا بيقول إن الموضوع محتاج حكم كويس زي حكم القضاء
examples.english: My dad says the matter needs good judgment like the judgment of the judiciary.
examples.transliteration: Bābā biyʾūl en el-mawḍūʿ meḥtāg ḥokm kowayyes zayy ḥokm el-qaḍāʾ.

examples.arabic: بابا قال: إحنا لازم نروح السوق النهاردة يا حلوين.
examples.english: Dad said: We must go to the market today, my dears.
examples.transliteration: Baba aal: Ehna lazam narouh el soo2 ennaharda ya helwein.

examples.arabic: بابا اشترى لحمة من الجزار.
examples.english: Dad bought meat from the butcher.
examples.transliteration: Baba eshtara la7ma men el gazzar.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

examples.arabic: أختي بتسأل عن أهداف البلاد دي.
examples.english: My sister asks about the goals of these countries.
examples.transliteration: Okhti bitisal an ahdaf el-bilad di.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: فرح اختي بكرة واحنا مبسوطين اوي
examples.english: My sister's wedding is tomorrow and we are very happy.
examples.transliteration: farah okhty bokra we ehna mabsoteen awy

examples.arabic: اختي الصغيره قاعده جنبي
examples.english: My little sister is sitting next to me.
examples.transliteration: okhty elsoghayara aada ganby

examples.arabic: كل يوم جمعة، العيلة بتاكل كشري سوا.
examples.english: Every Friday, the family eats koshary together.
examples.transliteration: Kol yom Gom3a, el 3eila betakel koshary sawa.

examples.arabic: العيلة كلها قعدت على السفرة.
examples.english: The whole family sat at the dining table.
examples.transliteration: El 3eila kollaha 2a3adet 3ala el sofra.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

examples.arabic: العيلة هي كل حاجة في حياتي، وأنا فرحان معاهم.
examples.english: Family is everything in my life, and I am happy with them.
examples.transliteration: El eila heya kol haga fee hayaty, we ana farhan maahom.

examples.arabic: كل الاهل بيتجمعوا في البيت على العشا
examples.english: All the family gathers at home for dinner.
examples.transliteration: Kol el ahl byetgama'u fel beet 'ala el 'asha

examples.arabic: الكل بيقول اهلا ازيكوا يا اهل
examples.english: Everyone says "hello, how are you, family".
examples.transliteration: El kol bi'ool "ahlan izzayku ya ahl".

examples.arabic: النهاردة الأهل كلهم في البيت
examples.english: Today all the family are at home.
examples.transliteration: Ennaharda el ahl kulluhum fi el beit.

examples.arabic: يوسف: أنا كنت في البيت مع أهلي.
examples.english: Youssef: I was at home with my family.
examples.transliteration: Youssef: Ana kont fel beit ma3 ahly.

examples.arabic: بعد ما زرت اهلي في بيوتهم قررت اعمل اكلة جديدة شفتها هناك
examples.english: After I visited my family in their houses, I decided to make a new dish I saw there.
examples.transliteration: Ba'd ma zort ahly fi beyoot'hom qarrart a'mel akla gedida shoftaha henāk.
examples.storyTitle: A Dish I Cooked for the First Time

examples.arabic: امي سألت راجل طيب وقالت لو سمحت يا عمو بيت اهلي فين
examples.english: My mother asked a kind man and said 'Excuse me uncle, where is my family's house?'
examples.transliteration: Ommy sa'alet ragel tayeb we 'alet law samaht ya 'ammu bayt ahly fein

examples.arabic: العيال الصغيرين نطوا في الشارع والجيران فتحوا شبابيكهم.
examples.english: The small children jumped in the street and the neighbors opened their windows.
examples.transliteration: El eyal el soghayarin nato fel share' wel geran fataho shababikhom.

examples.arabic: انا بشرب الشاي بتاعي وبلعب مع بنتي
examples.english: I drink my tea and play with my daughter.
examples.transliteration: ana bashrab el shay betaei we balab ma benty

examples.arabic: قاعدين على السفرة بنتي مريم بتصور الأكل بالتليفون
examples.english: Sitting at the dining table my daughter Maryam is photographing the food with her phone
examples.transliteration: Qa3deen 3ala el sofra benti Maryam betsawwar el akl bel telephon

examples.arabic: اتفضلي يا بنتي الفلوس بتاعتك اهي
examples.english: Here you go, my daughter, here is your money.
examples.transliteration: Etfaḍḍali ya binti, el-felus beta'tik ahi.

examples.arabic: انا بقعد جنب ابويا
examples.english: I sit next to my father.
examples.transliteration: Ana baaod ganb abouya

examples.arabic: ابويا عايز يصلح النور دلوقتي
examples.english: My father wants to fix the light now.
examples.transliteration: abouya ayiz yesallah el noor delwaqti

examples.arabic: ابويا بيتكلم وبيضحك مع اخويا
examples.english: My father is talking and laughing with my brother.
examples.transliteration: abouya beyetkallem we beyedhak maa akhouya

examples.arabic: كريم سال امه الفاكهة دي بكام وليه بنحب الجزر
examples.english: Karim asked his mother, "How much is this fruit, and why do we love carrots?"
examples.transliteration: Kareem sa'al ommo el fakha di bekam w leih benhebb el gazar.

examples.arabic: الجد ضحك وقال وعليكم السلام بس فين فطارك
examples.english: The grandfather laughed and said and upon you be peace but where is your breakfast
examples.transliteration: El ged dehek wa aal wa alaykum as salam bas feen fetarak

examples.arabic: الجد الكبير والولد الصغير بيتفرجوا على ماتش كورة
examples.english: The old grandfather and the young boy are watching a football match.
examples.transliteration: El ged el kibeer wel walad el sagheer beitfaraggu 'ala match kora

examples.arabic: الجد قاله ازيك يا كريم انا كويس الحمد لله
examples.english: The grandfather said to him, "How are you, Karim? I'm good, alhamdulillah."
examples.transliteration: El-gadd qāllo: "Izzayyak ya Karim? Ana kwayyes, el-ḥamdulillah."

examples.arabic: العيال الصغيرين نطوا في الشارع والجيران فتحوا شبابيكهم.
examples.english: The small children jumped in the street and the neighbors opened their windows.
examples.transliteration: El eyal el soghayarin nato fel share' wel geran fataho shababikhom.

examples.arabic: ابني بيسال كتير اوي
examples.english: My son asks very much.
examples.transliteration: ibni biyesal kitir awi

examples.arabic: ابني الصغير قالي يا بابا فيه خير قولتله لأ مفيش اي خير
examples.english: My little son asked me, 'Dad, is everything good?' I told him, 'No, nothing is good.'
examples.transliteration: ebnī eṣ-ṣoġayyar ʾalī ya baba fīh ḫeir? ʾoltelo la' mafīš ay ḫeir.

examples.arabic: فكر في أبوه اللي كان بيعلمه "لازم تكون واضح يا ابني"، وبص على الوادل اللي باين عليه بيروح الشغل كل يوم ده، وقرر إنه لازم يطلب حالا عشان لازم ندرس للامتحان.
examples.english: He thought of his father, who always taught him, "You must be clear, my son," and looked at the waiter who clearly goes to work every day, then decided he must order now because they must study for the exam.
examples.transliteration: Fakkar fi abooh elly kan beya'allimoh "lazim takoon wadeh ya ebny," w bass 'ala el-wadil elly bayen 'aleih beyrouh esh-shoghl koll yom dah, w qarar enno lazim yetlob halan 'ashan lazim nedres lel-emtehan.

examples.arabic: الاب بيضحك ويبوس ابنه
examples.english: The father laughs and kisses his son.
examples.transliteration: el ab beyedhak wa beybous ebnouh

examples.arabic: الاب و الام قاعدين على السفرة
examples.english: The father and mother are sitting at the dining table.
examples.transliteration: El ab w el omm qa'dein 'ala el sofra.

examples.arabic: عم حامد شاور على قهوة قريبة وقال: "يا ابني، متقلقش. أهو، روح قهوة الحاج فؤاد اللي هناك، يمكن تلاقي أَب صاحبك، عمو محمود، هو دايماً هناك الصبح بدري، ودايماً بيجيب كتاب معاه."
examples.english: Uncle Hamed pointed to a nearby coffeehouse and said: "Son, don't worry. There, go to Hajj Fouad's coffeehouse over there, maybe you'll find your friend's father, Uncle Mahmoud; he's always there early in the morning, and he always brings a book with him."
examples.transliteration: Am Hamed shawar ala ahwa qariba w qal: "Ya ebny, matqalqish. Aho, ruh ahwet el-Hag Fouad elli henaka, yumkin tala'i ab sahibak, ammo Mahmoud, howa dayman henaka el-sobh badri, w dayman biygeeb ketab ma'ah."
examples.storyTitle: A Book's Journey in Khan el-Khalili

examples.arabic: شفت عمي اللي بيشتغل هناك
examples.english: I saw my uncle who works there.
examples.transliteration: shoft ammi elli biyeshtaghal henak

examples.arabic: هنروح نزور عمي وعيلته هناك
examples.english: We will go to visit my uncle and his family there.
examples.transliteration: Hanrooh nezour ammy wa eylto henak

examples.arabic: عمي محمد هيجيب الدي جي
examples.english: My paternal uncle Mohamed will bring the DJ.
examples.transliteration: 3ammi Mohamed haygeb el DJ

examples.arabic: عمو سامي دخل وقال انتي شوفتي هدير انا لسه سايباها في المول من ساعه
examples.english: Uncle Sami came in and said: Did you see Hadeer? I just left her at the mall an hour ago.
examples.transliteration: 3ammo Sami dakhal we qal enti shofti Hadeer ana lessa saybaha fi el mol men sa3a

examples.arabic: شفت راجل كبير قولتلو يا عمو لو سمحت
examples.english: I saw an old man, I said to him, "Uncle, please."
examples.transliteration: Shoft ragel kebir, oltelo ya 'ammo law samaht.

examples.arabic: شفت راجل كبير، قولت عفواً يا عمو
examples.english: I saw an old man, I said "Excuse me, uncle".
examples.transliteration: Shoft ragel kibeer, olt "Afwan ya ammu".

examples.arabic: هو كان مع اخواتي في البيت امبارح
examples.english: He was with my siblings in the house yesterday.
examples.transliteration: hwa kan ma akhwati fi el beit embareh

examples.arabic: امبارح كلمت اخواتي علشان نخطط لرحلة العيلة يوم السبت
examples.english: Yesterday I talked to my siblings to plan for the family trip on Saturday.
examples.transliteration: Embareh kallimt akhwati ashan nekhattat le rehlet el eila yom el sabt
